body: RAG and durable process memory (decision ledgers, ADRs, correction history) are needed across all platform editions, but community/local editions require zero-external-dependency storage while enterprise/SaaS requires scalable pgvector. This adapter provides a unified interface across all editions.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.problem: Knowledge item indexing, architectural memory, and code search require vector storage that operates both embedded locally with zero external dependencies (PF-SB / community) and cloud-scalable with tenant isolation (PF-PG / enterprise / PF-GP).
brief.what_adds: Dual-Engine RAG and Memory Storage Adapter (go/dualvec) implementing datastore.MemoryRepository with SQLite vector backend and PostgreSQL pgvector backend, unified DSN auto-dispatch, and shared conformance tests.
brief.why: Unifies memory and retrieval across local sovereign single binaries and enterprise cloud clusters while allowing Generated Products (PF-GP) to target both environments without code changes.
brief.who_feels: Product Forge developers, PF-SB sovereign air-gapped users, enterprise SaaS operators, and generated product consumers.

label: PF Backlog 687
risks: SQLite-vss platform compilation compatibility on Windows mitigated via pre-built extension binaries.
title: Dual-Engine RAG and Memory Storage Adapter: embedded SQLite-vss for local editions and PostgreSQL pgvector for enterprise
summary: Implement a dual-engine storage adapter interface for vector and lexical retrieval that transparently switches between embedded SQLite-vss (local) and PostgreSQL/pgvector (enterprise).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_memory.py, core/generator_adapters.py, core/intake_adapters.py, core/memory_api.py

approach: Implement go/dualvec package implementing datastore.MemoryRepository: SqliteMemoryStore with packed-float cosine similarity and FTS matching for PF-SB, and PgMemoryStore over PostgreSQL pgvector for PF-PG/enterprise, auto-dispatched via DSN scheme. Documented in docs/DUAL-VECTOR-STORE-DESIGN.md.
rollback: Revert to lexical BM25 search fallback in core/search.py.

objective: Build a pluggable dual-engine vector adapter supporting embedded SQLite-vss for community/local editions and pgvector for enterprise SaaS clusters.

api_impact.reason: Packaging, deployment, and verification CLI/core capability; no dedicated HTTP routes required

verification: go test -v ./go/dualvec/... passes conformance tests on SQLite and PostgreSQL
go test -v ./go/edpsvc/... passes with dualvec integration
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Vector storage adapter implements datastore.MemoryRepository across SQLite (local/PF-SB) and PostgreSQL pgvector (enterprise/PF-PG) backends.
AC-2: Community edition & PF-SB run zero-dependency local vector store using SQLite without requiring external daemon infrastructure or compiled C extensions.
AC-3: Enterprise edition & PF-GP SaaS switch to PostgreSQL pgvector with tenant isolation and row-level security enforcement via DSN auto-dispatch.
AC-4: Shared conformance test suite verifies 8 canonical memory types, 1536-dim vector validation, ACL scoping, and zero cross-tenant leakage across both engines.

BLOCKER: AC-2 states "without requiring ... compiled C extensions", but the design explicitly uses "SQLite-vss" which is a compiled C extension, directly contradicting the acceptance criterion.
MAJOR: The design states RLS enforcement but does not explicitly prove the runtime role posture (NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS) as required by CL-011.
The design lacks details on observability, specifically what metrics and logs will be emitted to diagnose failures or monitor the performance of the dual-engine vector store.
The design does not address availability concerns for the underlying databases or how the adapter behaves if the database is unavailable.
MINOR: The design does not explicitly cover recovery procedures for an interrupted migration, especially concerning data in the new vector stores.
Beyond vector dimension validation, other critical data invariants (e.g., uniqueness of IDs, ordering guarantees) are not explicitly stated or tested.
Explicit backup and restore procedures for the vector data, particularly for the SQLite-vss store, are not detailed.

sig:24d5d84fe20dbbdd.note: Replaced sqlite-vss with pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite and embedded packed-float SIMD-friendly cosine distance calculation, completely eliminating CGO and external dynamic libraries for 100% air-gapped portability.

sig:7fc3a724191b310b.note: PgMemoryStore operates under restricted non-superuser role pf_app_user with BYPASSRLS revoked, guaranteeing native PostgreSQL Row-Level Security tenant boundary enforcement.

sig:ec44e65a1b7fe07a.note: Added Section 4 to DUAL-VECTOR-STORE-DESIGN.md specifying structured query logging (engine, tenant, project, duration_ms) and Prometheus metrics (dualvec_operations_total, dualvec_duration_seconds).

sig:496db858093928c6.note: Fail-closed design: store initialization verifies connection health via PingContext and returns typed ErrStorageUnavailable; all operations accept context.Context timeouts.

sig:2a30091c83d5c500.note: Schemas use idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with atomic index creation on startup, ensuring clean recovery from interrupted boots.

sig:6a37ca152e66b63e.note: Enforced PRIMARY KEY on memory_entries(id) preventing duplicate entries; vector writes strictly validate EmbeddingDim == 1536; deterministic hybrid score ranking.

sig:a413131ea63df00d.note: Replaced sqlite-vss with pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite and embedded packed-float SIMD-friendly cosine distance calculation, completely eliminating CGO and external dynamic libraries for 100% air-gapped portability.

scope: Dual-engine vector and memory storage adapter implementing datastore.MemoryRepository in go/dualvec
Embedded SQLite vector store for PF-SB local sovereign bundle and local generated products
PostgreSQL pgvector adapter for PF-PG enterprise SaaS and cloud generated products
Auto-dispatching factory resolving sqlite:// vs postgres:// DSNs
Shared conformance test suite verifying all 8 memory types, 1536-dim vector validation, ACL scoping, and negative leakage isolation
non_goals: External SaaS vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate)

design_areas.reason: Dual-engine vector and memory storage adapter

requirements.title: Unified datastore.MemoryRepository implementation in go/dualvec
requirements.preconditions: Caller initializes dualvec.Config with either SQLite or PostgreSQL DSN.
requirements.trigger: Application or pipeline stage calls Put, Get, Search, or Delete.
inputs: MemoryEntry or MemoryScope with query text, vector, tenant, project, and ACL
outputs: Stored MemoryEntry or ranked list of MemoryEntry hits
errors: Validation error on dimension mismatch, storage error on DB down
requirements.auth: Server-side principal check; private entries restricted to owner
requirements.idempotency: Put with identical ID updates the record idempotently
data_rules: Primary key on id; dimension must strictly match 1536
edge_cases: Zero vector embedding; empty search query; special chars
acceptance: Given valid memory entries, when Put or Search is invoked, then correct entries are stored and retrieved.

requirements.title: Zero-CGO pure-Go embedded SQLite vector store for PF-SB and local products
requirements.preconditions: DSN starts with sqlite://, file:, or is a local path.
requirements.auth: Enforced in query predicate before results returned
requirements.idempotency: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on startup is idempotent
edge_cases: File lock contention; concurrent read/write transactions
acceptance: Given SQLite DSN, when dualvec.New is called, then pure-Go SQLite store runs without CGO.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL pgvector adapter for enterprise cloud SaaS and PF-GP
requirements.preconditions: DSN starts with postgres:// or postgresql://.
inputs: PostgreSQL DSN and tenant bound connection
requirements.auth: PostgreSQL RLS with restricted application role pf_app_user
requirements.idempotency: Upsert on memory table is idempotent
data_rules: GIN lexical indexing and pgvector HNSW cosine ranking
edge_cases: pgvector extension missing; RLS policy violations
acceptance: Given Postgres DSN, when dualvec.New is called, then pgvector backend is wired with RLS.

requirements.title: Strict multi-tenant, project, and ACL privacy isolation
requirements.preconditions: Memory entries are stored across multiple tenants, projects, and users.
inputs: MemoryScope containing TenantID, Project, User, ACL, and Kinds
outputs: Hits filtered strictly to the caller tenant, project, and ACL
requirements.auth: Caller user can only access private entries owned by them
data_rules: Cross-tenant data must never appear in query results
acceptance: Given multiple tenants, when tenant A queries, then zero tenant B rows are returned.

config_contract.PF_MEMORY_DSN: Connection string selecting SQLite or PostgreSQL

nfr: Pure Go zero CGO portability for SQLite
functional_spec.data_lifecycle: Memory entries retained per retention policy; soft/hard delete supported
functional_spec.rollback: Unset PF_MEMORY_DSN to revert to legacy PostgreSQL store
functional_spec.observability: Structured logs (engine, tenant, project, duration_ms) and Prometheus metrics
open_questions: No open questions; dual-engine auto-dispatch resolved.
